descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Geisha Gone Wild' Pink Variegated Japanese Maple Zones 5 - 9 'Geisha Gone Wild' Japanese maple was found as a variegated sport off of 'Geisha'. 'Geisha Gone Wild' is a beauty that leafs out with bright pink margined variegation on a deeper red. By summer, in full sun in the south the leaf on 'Geisha Gone Wild' changes to a green with cream variegation. When given morning sun and afternoon shade, the spring pink and red coloration maintains for the longest amount of time. 'Geisha Gone Wild' will reach 7 ft in 10 years with a vase-like shape. Fall colors on the 'Geisha Gone Wild' Japanese maple are a hot pink to bright purples.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Geisha Gone Wild' 粉色斑锦日本枫，适生分区 5-9。 'Geisha Gone Wild' 是从 'Geisha' 上发现的一枝斑锦芽变。 它展叶时非常美丽，深红色叶片上镶有鲜亮的粉色斑锦叶缘。 到了夏季，在南方全日照条件下，'Geisha Gone Wild' 的叶片会转为绿色，并带有乳白色斑锦。 若给予上午阳光、下午遮阴，其春季的粉色与红色叶色可维持更长时间。 'Geisha Gone Wild' 在 10 年内可长至约 7 英尺，树形呈花瓶状。 秋季叶色为亮粉色至鲜亮紫色。
